summary: tail's live-dogfood happy-path fixture polls workflows instead of community-packages.
reason: A one-shot tail of an empty resource emits an empty NDJSON stream, which the JSON-fidelity probe reads as invalid JSON. community-packages is empty on most n8n instances; workflows is not. Behavior of tail itself is unchanged.
validated_outcome: tail workflows --follow=false --json emits one data event per workflow on the local test instance.
